units.content: Tests verify deterministic balanced evidence, single built-in structural-family identity, namespaced case generation, and distinct generator buckets without treating buckets as structural independence.
Tests verify nuisance/error distributions are label-independent, prospective signal structure identifies failure depth in expectation, and diagnosis is label-blind under relabeling/renaming attacks.
Tests verify minimum sufficient intervention depths 0/1/2, decomposed/costly revision outcomes, fully crossed matched agent populations, and separability of controller choice from diagnostic quality.

Eligibility tests attack metadata resealing, renamed built-in identity, declared built-in derivation, shared target-manufacturing source/helpers/evaluation assumptions, prior-outcome access, incomplete provenance, and independence laundering; all are expected to fail closed.

Attestation/design tests attack missing or non-independent attestations, self-attestation, author=attestor identity, version/schema mismatch, scientific-hash drift, internal binding divergence, post-hoc design mutation, and tampered attestation hashes; all are expected to remain ineligible.

Outcome-authority tests distinguish failed validity or failed eligibility from a valid null: only an eligible validity-passing evidence run may become valid_negative and evidence-bearing; per-failure heterogeneity is never a third top-level evidence class.
Installed-wheel test executes MAGIKARP outside the source checkout and verifies that successful smoke remains builtin L0, engineering_only, evidence_ready=false, and evidence_bearing=false.
Configuration tests freeze diagnostic skill levels, controller ordering, ridge alpha, positive threshold/CI rule, and built-in generator scope; scientific parameter drift is rejected.

Manifest tests verify deterministic serialization and rejection of unrelated repositories, unfrozen/mismatched manifests, altered definitions, wrong Git commit/runtime, and source/authority divergence.
Validity tests verify all six gates are machine-readable and jointly required, including explicit failure when the interface-collision condition does not hold.

Metric/analysis tests verify frozen SD endpoints, class-balanced diagnostics, invalid-probability rejection, aggregation against episode pseudoreplication, and failure stratification within generator buckets.

Predictive-analysis tests verify informative SD can improve held-out prediction in fixtures, whole matched-agent-block exclusion, whole generator-bucket exclusion, deterministic paired bootstrap, and explicit bootstrap unit/confidence semantics.
Runner tests verify deterministic end-to-end smoke execution can pass all validity gates while remaining engineering_only, evidence_ready=false, and evidence_bearing=false.
Runner tests verify failed validity gates suppress grouped outer prediction and evidence mode refuses execution without a frozen manifest.
Runner tests preserve a valid primary null despite secondary heterogeneity, verify frozen namespaces affect generated data, operational bootstrap settings, and explicit overwrite safety.

GitHub Actions run 31252073027 on PR #1 completed successfully with jobs 93089832343 (Python 3.11.15) and 93089832323 (Python 3.12.13); each job executed installation, 61 unit tests, deterministic engineering smoke, and the smoke-boundary assertion.

Both retrieved CI job logs report the same smoke diagnostic: delta_MAE=-0.005430183597072646 with 95% interval [-0.006750692500288286,-0.0029628877700948186], validity_passed=true, independence_level=L0, status=engineering_only, evidence_ready=false, evidence_bearing=false. This is observed engineering output, not a scientific negative.
